test_title: PYST 16: SSC CHSL 2024 - English (Held On: 04 Jul, 2024 Shift 4)
subject: english
question:
Select the most appropriate option of the given word to fill in the blank.

The new construction sites have _______ attack by the environmentalists.
solution:
The correct answer is: **come under.**

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The context tells us that environmentalists have launched an attack on the new development sites.
 
• The phrase **"come under attack"** is an idiomatic expression meaning to be criticized or targeted.
 
• None of the other options fit the context of the sentence as appropriately as "come under."

​Hence, the correct sentence is: *The new construction sites have **come under__** attack by the environmentalists*.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **"Come off"** usually means to succeed or to happen as planned, which doesn't fit here.
 
• **"Come upon"** means to find or discover by chance, which is also not suitable.
 
• **"Come out"** means to be revealed or released, which does not fit the context either.
